recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the active example-source mismatch without expanding into FHIR-40765's broader cross-resource alignment question. Regenerate, rather than hand-edit, the ServiceRequest SVG if the publication process requires checked-in diagram artifacts to be refreshed.
issue_request: FHIR-26674 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification and requested replacing ServiceRequest.asNeeded[x] with separate asNeeded and asNeededFor elements, adding the asn-1 invariant, updating reason/asNeeded/asNeededFor definitions, and adding examples that distinguish as-needed criteria from the reason for the service request.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3230, including commit 0fe699b16df0d6ec738db9253849043f8140cef9 and merge 75b721ec04, updated structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml, added asn-1, split the elements, changed reason wording, and added glucose examples. That application left one older active physiotherapy example using the removed asNeededCodeableConcept choice element and added a glucose example whose asNeededFor content used a CodeableReference-style concept wrapper instead of CodeableConcept XML.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists ServiceRequest and ServiceRequest.asNeededFor, and list-ServiceRequest-examples.xml includes both edited examples. Zulip and OO minutes support the distinction that reason explains why the order exists, while asNeeded/asNeededFor describes the trigger or criteria for performing it. Related FHIR-40765 was Resolved - No Change because FHIR-26674 had already addressed the distinction. A checked-in generated-looking ServiceRequest SVG still contains stale asNeeded[x] text and was not manually edited; if diagrams are treated as authoritative build inputs, it should be regenerated from the corrected StructureDefinition.
reconciliation: Changed source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-glucose.xml so ServiceRequest.asNeededFor directly contains CodeableConcept text, and changed source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example2.xml to use asNeeded true plus asNeededFor text instead of the removed asNeededCodeableConcept element.
source_changes: source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-glucose.xml: removed the incorrect CodeableReference concept wrapper under asNeededFor so the element is represented as a CodeableConcept.
source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example2.xml: replaced the removed asNeededCodeableConcept choice element with asNeeded=true and asNeededFor text.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive because of the work done in FHIR-26674; supports limiting this reconciliation to ServiceRequest example consistency rather than reopening cross-resource alignment.
